descriptions.rgb: The scene is a small tiled bathroom under renovation, viewed from an elevated position near an interior wall on the right covered with an orange gridded backer board, with an open closet doorway containing shelf boxes about 1.5 to 2 metres ahead and a lit hallway doorway about 2.5 metres ahead on the left.
